title: 编码EEG信号以检验语言模型类人下一词预测行为
summary: 本研究通过EEG记录的事件相关电位（ERP），比较人类与语言模型在下一词预测任务中的认知信号。发现仅surprisal指标与语言处理ERP相关，且扩大模型规模并不必然提升与人类语言处理的一致性。
summary_en: This study compares cognitive signals between humans and language models in next-word prediction using EEG-recorded ERPs. It finds that only surprisal correlates with language-processing ERPs, and scaling models does not guarantee convergence with human-like linguistic processing.
